blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—EJ Castillo had no shortage of motivation in Emilio Aguinaldo College’s latest win in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament. On paper, it was just another win for the Generals, who improved to 2-3. For Castillo, though, it was a full-circle moment that reminded him why he plays the game he loves. Castillo wore the Nike Kobe 8 “Mambacurial” in EAC’s 89-79 win over Lyceum at San Juan Arena on Friday and delivered a game-high 23 points. It was his first personal pair of Kobe shoes–a meaningful moment for someone who once had to borrow shoes just to play […]...
